authority.user_instruction: Add independently verifiable portable evidence and real recovery behavior one bounded unit at a time without changing the approved manifest authority, machine CLI, Docker trust boundary, or evidence-state semantics.

scope.objective: Freeze and implement append-only, content-addressed portable receipts; durable idempotent event history; state-separated interruption recovery; verified PostgreSQL backup and clean restore; and an independent offline verifier on the already verified local topology.
forbidden_work: Changing the approved product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, or evidence semantics
Mounting a Docker or container-engine socket into any container
Giving containers secrets, privileged mode, host network, broad host mounts, or external runtime network
Creating or changing a real workflow approval or executing repository workflow input
Deleting, mounting into a new project, relabeling, renaming, or otherwise mutating any protected IS-0003 evidence volume
Using a dependency before its exact source, integrity, license, vulnerability, and compatibility gate passes
Adding dashboard, registry publication, image redistribution, release, cloud, Kubernetes, multi-tenancy, or arbitrary remote execution work
Claiming tests, source inspection, a live database alone, or a later successful attempt overwrites prior evidence
reversible_actions: Create closed schemas, fixtures, canonicalization vectors, locks, mutation harnesses, ADRs, and documentation
Implement host-owned portable receipt custody and an offline verifier using source-gated dependencies or the standard library
Extend the stable CLI with additive evidence and recovery commands that preserve existing command and exit semantics
Use only fixed non-sensitive disposable staging, containers, networks, and volumes for destructive recovery probes
Create and verify PostgreSQL dumps and restores in bounded disposable custody
Retain immutable failed, invalid, cancelled, stale, superseded, and corrupted attempts
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A required change would alter the core promise, trust boundary, approval authority, or weaken an explicit security or evidence gate
A dependency or artifact cannot pass the applicable source, integrity, license, vulnerability, or compatibility gate
A recovery probe cannot prove that every protected volume remains untouched
A test would require a secret, real sensitive data, consequential action, paid service, access or ownership change, or irreversible operation
An evidence state cannot remain distinguishable and independently verifiable
A checkpoint or release claim cannot be verified from clean local and public custody

units.purpose: Freeze the portable receipt, artifact, event-chain, run-summary, custody, canonicalization, and offline-verification contracts with valid, invalid, corruption, truncation, reordering, replay, and state-separation vectors before implementation.
inputs: Frozen CLI and run-event v1 contract
retained_failures: The base Python full-schema attempt was INVALID because evaluation-only jsonschema was intentionally absent. An exact source-gated temporary evaluator then passed. Two policy-rejected cleanup wrappers remain INVALID; exact non-canonical non-OneDrive temporary dependency custody is retained.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Two closed schemas, exact RFC 8785 receipt and event-link vectors, raw artifact identity, 17 locked files, full Draft 2020-12 validation, and all 14 fail-closed mutations passed without Docker runtime.

units.purpose: Implement an atomic append-only portable receipt store and an independent offline verifier that requires no Docker, PostgreSQL, network, approval state, secret, or repository write access.
retained_failures: Five evaluator attempts remain INVALID: state-separated error lookup, pre-write custody detection, direct base-interpreter meta-validation, intentional receipt CLI drift rejected by the prior topology implementation lock, and an incorrect public candidate prefix rejected before cloning. Corrected governed paths pass without erasing those attempts.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The exact public candidate reproduced atomic content-addressed custody, independent state-separated verification, runtime self-binding, twelve implementation mutations, and clean-copy integrity without credentials or runtime authority.

units.purpose: Persist monotonic append-only run events with deterministic idempotency keys, duplicate replay handling, and explicit stale and superseded transitions while preserving every prior attempt.
inputs: Verified receipt store and offline verifier
retained_failures: The resume inspection retained an invalid PowerShell Git-tree wrapper and an IS_USAGE policy-status call before corrected read-only observations passed.
The first implementation mutation harness incorrectly accepted a broadened SECURITY DEFINER search path; the tightened validator then rejected all eight mutations.
The first real PostgreSQL probe reused an occupied sequence for authority drift and correctly returned IS_JOURNAL_CONFLICT before the intended authority gate; corrected isolated custody passes.
Local command policy denied the exact final temporary-clone cleanup wrapper before execution; the verified clean clone remains non-canonical, outside OneDrive, and outside runtime custody.
The first final binding-check wrapper had a PowerShell empty-pipe parser error before execution; the corrected read-only wrapper matched every exact binding.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Exact credential-free public custody reproduced atomic immutable PostgreSQL append, exact replay and conflict gates, state-separated JSONL, restart persistence, least privilege, protected-volume identity, disposable runtime teardown, Git integrity, and secret scanning.

units.purpose: Add host crash reconciliation and durable cancellation/failure recovery at bounded boundaries, proving that lifecycle failure never fabricates or erases a verification verdict.
retained_failures: The first focused recovery test omitted the standard src path bootstrap and executed no test; the corrected test and all 68 repository tests pass.
The first full-schema wrapper could not resolve the already source-gated wheel URLs and acquired nothing; offline hash-verified reuse of retained exact custody passed two schemas and 26 fixtures.
One read-only rg wrapper used an invalid Windows wildcard path before the corrected directory-scoped search.
The first concise full-validation wrapper treated unittest's normal stderr progress as a terminating PowerShell error before checking Python's exit; the corrected replay passed.
A CLI --help inspection returned the expected IS_USAGE because help is outside the frozen machine grammar; the supported policy status command was used instead.
One read-only CLI search was rejected by PowerShell quoting before rg executed; the corrected literal search completed.
The first policy status invocation used a nonexistent fixture path and returned IS_MANIFEST_READ; the corrected exact path returned MISSING at exit 12.
The exact verified public-clone cleanup command was denied by local command policy before execution; the clean noncanonical clone remains retained outside OneDrive and runtime custody.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The candidate freezes content-addressed observations, fenced ownership, exact replay/continue/stop/cancel/fail/stale/defer decisions, and strict recovery-verdict versus run-lifecycle separation. Real host, Docker, journal, restart, and clean-public implementation evidence remains required.
